reviews.title: i like it
reviews.text: i do enjoy it and it’s cute and helpful. i just wish there was a way to log my water consumption as fl oz as opposed to cups? maybe im missing something but that’s my only complaint at the moment.

reviews.title: Want to love but….
reviews.text:
I want to love this app so much. The concept is awesome. The idea is there.But the ai ruins it.

I don’t care about unlocking the stories because the “art” and writing is all ai. I don’t care about unlocking foods for the capybara because all of the images are ai. 

I haven’t really been using it much because it feels like no effort went into the visuals. And since it’s ai, the different styles are very inconsistent and it looks like some kid stuck random stickers all over a picture book. For the price, they should be able to hire real human artists and writers.

reviews.title: Not Free
reviews.text: Cannot use free. Prompted to subscribe to free trial then monthly or yearly. Why would I pay for something I haven’t used and no a week free trial is not going to let me try this out. If anything it just shows what kinda app this is. Not helping others with goals but taking money. Many diet apps are free to use and have a subscription. Don’t see why this one isn’t.

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: I put in all my information only to immediately get prompted to start a free trial for one week no option to skip it. I agree to it and then all of a sudden the app couldn’t find my information so immediately canceled and uninstalled it.

reviews.title: No updates!
reviews.text: I would happily change this review to five stars, but there have been no substantive updates and I’m worried it’s been abandoned.  That’s a shame because the idea for the app is great.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: I just feel like before having a person build a profile there should be SOME warning in the actual app that there is a full paywall. It is listed all the way at the bottom of the app description by an asterisk but I had to search. I understand it is a marketing method to entice you to keep the app, but it really was a waste to create for me personally.

reviews.title: The best weight loss app that I’ve used! Worth the money!
reviews.text: This is the best weight loss app that I’ve used! It is worth the money. I’ve been looking for a weight loss app where I can track my weight, calories, and one that has a meal planner. With CapyDiet it can track your weight, exercise, calories, and plans your weekly meals for you. The meals are very easy to make, are low in calories, and very selective. You can even change them to your preference on there! It also gives you feedback on your daily meals,exercise, and how you can improve it. What makes it even better is that you have a little Capybara companion that you can dress up and play mini games with. I’m seeing a lot of progress and this app has really motivated me to lose weight.

reviews.title: It is so fun
reviews.text: I love it so much

reviews.title: Guidance with features
reviews.text: No longer loving the app - no one from support will respond back to me regarding questions. I am over it and will go with another calorie tracker.

reviews.title: Must pay to use without info on $
reviews.text:
I love the games where there is motivation to buy your pet something or decorate. Like the apps Finch or Bitepal. However these games have a free version and premium add on features. I chose to use these apps because I got to check them out without premium features and see if this app works for me.

 When I got this app I immediately had to do a free trail and I could not see how much the actually cost was. Bitepal does the first year premium $2.99 a month while this app charges that a week. It seems like there is also a $5.99 per month option too.

reviews.title: Very great app
reviews.text: I am using this app with my young daughter for health reasons.This is the only app I’ve found that appropriately calculates an intake for a person her age. (Others calculate unsustainable/unhealthy levels because they are for adults) the only comments I have is that food logging is a little clunky if you are trying to log something a day later it tends to auto add it to the current day, I wish you could edit the date in the “edit entry” section. I also wish more of the food selections could be broken down into gram servings instead of just whole packaged servings

reviews.title: So much fun
reviews.text: I lost 8 pounds in 16 weeks

reviews.title: Took my money
reviews.text: Took my money without notifying me and I’ve contacted multiple times for a refund but they never responded. Do not recommend this app.

reviews.title: Paid app, not free
reviews.text: You can download this app for free, but to actually use it you need to pay for it. It asks you to put in your info (height weight any goals) but that’s as much interaction you get. Then you’re taken to page where you can try to app for $0 but of course that means agreeing to one of the subscription options.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: I used this app in the past and it was free and now it’s a subscription that you don’t find out about til after you sign up.

reviews.title: Adorable Calorie Counter
reviews.text: I have already seen progress after a short amount of time using this app. It's so great and really convenient to use! My only wish is that it had better furniture /decor options. It feels like they haven't really given much care or thought to that part of the app, which to me was the selling point. I use the Finch app and it has furniture /clothes for every place you visit and depending on the month. There's a new theme every month and it's super cute! I wish this app had more features like that.

reviews.title: DO NOT PURCHASE
reviews.text: I purchased this app and realized it wasn’t doing what I thought it would. I contacted Support to see if I can get a refund as I only had it for less than a day. No response back no support whatsoever. So I tried to work with the app and use it and was still having issues with it. It wouldn’t save my foods or it would over calculate certain meals. contacted support again and still no response.

reviews.title: Not cool
reviews.text:
Cute design. Liked the friendly feeling interface.
However, two big NOs from me. First is during the initial setup asking for a review. I haven't even gotten to the actual app!
Second, nowhere in the description did I see that a subscription is required to use the app at all. 
Deleted

reviews.text: This has so many helpful functions! I love how it graphs your progress and offers nutritional ideas for your next meal.  I also like how you can turn your progress into cute items for the capybara in the shop! Absolutely great app!

reviews.text: Typically apps have some free features, but not this one.

reviews.title: Almost a year in
reviews.text: The app does some things great. I like the tracking. But one of my motivations is being able to purchase things for my Capy. It’s been well over a month and there is nothing in the shop to shop for! Please refill the shop!!!!! Also, when there is a story to read, parts of the story get cut off and I’m unable to scroll to read the full script. I’m on an iPhone. I’d also like to be able to see a progress chart that covers a longer time period.

reviews.title: Forced to subscribe
reviews.text: I just downloaded the app and when i was filling my information they asked me to review the app (how? i haven’t used it yet to have an opinion) then to actually use the app they made me subscribe. there was no “X” button and no way to not subscribe. this is a very bad dark pattern, if you expect all users to pay then make the app payed, do not make it “free” and then force them to pay after they already downloaded it. I accepted the 7 days free trial to check but the app was lacking, felt very incomplete and it was just very boring. i will not be using the app and do not recommend to other people.

reviews.title: Good app but...
reviews.text: This app really helped me and its really cool to use but it’s just some times I get confused but overall best app to lose weight or gain some more weight

reviews.title: Cute and useful app!
reviews.text:
Thank you to the developers! This app is very colorful and fun to use. Food, exercise and water is easy to log. The decor is very cute and it is motivating to do the activities and earn the gems and leaves.  

I wish there was a way to make notes on each day.  And I wish we could log and get gems and leaves for other things besides diet,  Activity and water. For example: logging hours of sleep, meditation or relaxation, taking medications, or a spot to add in our own goals that are important to us to track each day.

reviews.title: Hmm
reviews.text: I used this app before and I loved it but now when I log on to the app it’s prompting me to become a premium member. I can’t afford premium. Is there no way I could use it for free ? Or do I have to pay for premium?

reviews.title: Wish I could save meals
reviews.text: I love this app, but I wish there was a way to save meals so I didn’t have to add every single ingredient everytime!

reviews.title: Super cute and helpful
reviews.text: I love this app because first off, it’s so cute! I hate the very boring fitness app that feel so serious and intimidating. This app actually makes weight loss and fitness and nutrition really fun! I like that you can earn points to “buy” and decorate your own little house. I do wish I could add more to my Capys home and there were a bit more cutesy, cozy things to purchase. I love that the app is extremely positive and suggestive and helpful! It makes me look forward to logging my progress. I’ve already lost ELEVEN POUNDS!!! 🎉🙌🥳

reviews.title: No Free Option
reviews.text:
This is on me for not reading the description, but for everyone that reads the reviews first there is no free version of this app. 

They do offer a free trial if you are interested in paying later down the line.

reviews.title: Money grabber

reviews.title: i love capydiet
reviews.text: i have tried at least 10 calorie tracking apps and nothing comes close to capy diet. the logging process is simple, and they offer features like ai scan and barcode scan for free, something that so many apps don’t have for free. they also don’t bombard you with pop ups telling you to get the pro version. there’s also like um the cute parts where you like go mining or fishing or something (i don’t use it that often) but it’s there if you need any other motivation. it’s also so clean and easy to use and i love my capybara he’s so cute. yah this is like a t1 app of all time

reviews.title: Friendly, guilt free app
reviews.text: I love this app so much. I’m a BIG guy and have been trying to lose weight for years, and in those years I was diagnosed with bulimia with atypical anorexic obsessive calorie counting. This app does not guilt you, it encourages you, gives you advice without making you feel bad. I’ve only been using it for a few days, and it has helped me drastically. Plus it’s so cute, I mean, it’s a capybara. Who doesn’t love capybaras? Def recommend, especially for those struggling with EDs.

reviews.title: Awesome app!
reviews.text: Such an awesome app, it’s super cute and interactive! Only downside is some of the advice and meal plan suggestions are not very sustainable or healthy to do, so I would suggest to take all of those with a grain of salt! Some of the meal plan suggestions are like 1500 calories a day, which is definitely way too little.

reviews.title: Adorable
reviews.text: How can anyone not love the idea of a capybara nutrition coach? Especially when your positive habits allow you to dress it up in cute outfits. I find the calorie/nutrition tracking aspect to be accurate, and the AI coaching to be really supportive and helpful. Such a fun change from all the other boring nutrition apps.

reviews.title: Cute but…..

But the only downside so far is that whenever I log in breakfast it doesn’t let me log in my other meals throughout the day. I don’t know if I am missing something but when I log my breakfast in the morning, it won’t let me tap again to log my lunch. Is it because I have to put my meals all in at once? Please help me out so that I can use the app better and it can be beneficial and worth the subscription.

reviews.title: Love it!
